name: Applied Physics for Engineers
description: Current first-year physics syllabus (2024-2026 papers): quantum mechanics, photoelectric effect, thermal radiation, Compton effect, lasers and optical fibres.

chapters.name: Quantum Mechanics
chapters.description: de Broglie waves, uncertainty principle, wave functions, Schrodinger equation, particle in a box, harmonic oscillator and tunnelling.

chapters.name: Photoelectric Effect
chapters.description: Photon theory, Einstein's photoelectric equation, stopping potential, work function and quantum efficiency.

chapters.name: Thermal Radiation
chapters.description: Blackbody radiation, Stefan-Boltzmann law, Wien's law, Rayleigh-Jeans law and the ultraviolet catastrophe.

chapters.name: Compton Effect & X-rays
chapters.description: Compton scattering, Compton shift, recoil electron and X-ray spectra.

chapters.name: Lasers
chapters.description: Spontaneous and stimulated emission, population inversion, Einstein coefficients, laser components and the ruby laser.

chapters.name: Optical Fibres
chapters.description: Total internal reflection, numerical aperture, acceptance angle, modes, dispersion and skip distance.

name: Engineering Physics
description: Older first-year engineering physics papers (2011-2017). Broader syllabus covering wave optics, modern physics and solid state physics.

chapters.name: Interference
chapters.description: Double-slit interference, thin films, Newton's rings, wedge films and the Michelson interferometer.

chapters.name: Diffraction & Gratings
chapters.description: Single-slit diffraction, circular apertures, resolving power, diffraction gratings and zone plates.

chapters.name: Polarization
chapters.description: Brewster's law, double refraction, optical activity and wave plates.

chapters.name: Quantum Mechanics
chapters.description: Wave packets, de Broglie hypothesis, uncertainty principle, wave functions and particle-in-a-box problems.

chapters.name: Atomic & Molecular Physics
chapters.description: Hydrogen atom, angular momentum, rotational and vibrational spectra of diatomic molecules.

chapters.name: X-rays & Compton Effect
chapters.description: Continuous and characteristic X-ray spectra, Moseley's law, Bragg diffraction and Compton scattering.

chapters.name: Lasers
chapters.description: Principle of laser action, emission processes and the ruby laser.

chapters.name: Optical Fibres
chapters.description: Light propagation, numerical aperture and acceptance angle.

chapters.name: Semiconductors & Solid State
chapters.description: Band theory, Fermi-Dirac statistics, density of states, carrier concentration and p-n junctions.

chapters.name: Superconductivity
chapters.description: Zero resistance, Meissner effect, BCS theory and superconducting rings.

chapters.name: Thermal Radiation
chapters.description: Blackbody laws and Wien's displacement law.

name: Basic Mechanical Engineering
description: First-year mechanical engineering fundamentals: steam and boilers, drives, IC engines, machine tools, manufacturing processes and power plants.

chapters.name: Steam & Boilers
chapters.description: Steam formation, enthalpy, quality, superheat, boiler types, mountings, accessories and efficiency.

chapters.name: Belt Drives
chapters.description: Flat belt drives, tension ratio, power transmission, belt length and fast/loose pulleys.

chapters.name: Gear Trains
chapters.description: Simple and compound gear trains, velocity ratio, module and centre distance.

chapters.name: IC Engines
chapters.description: Two- and four-stroke engines, carburettors, lubrication, indicated and brake thermal efficiency.

chapters.name: Machine Tools
chapters.description: Lathe operations and parts, drilling machines, reaming, boring and speed control.

chapters.name: Casting & Foundry
chapters.description: Patterns, moulding sand, allowances, green sand moulding and casting defects.

chapters.name: Welding & Joining
chapters.description: Arc welding, gas welding, TIG, resistance spot welding, soldering and brazing.

chapters.name: Additive Mfg. & CNC
chapters.description: Additive manufacturing steps, NC/CNC machines and their advantages and limitations.

chapters.name: Power Plants & Turbines
chapters.description: Thermal, nuclear and gas power plants, impulse and reaction turbines, water turbines.

chapters.name: Refrigeration
chapters.description: Vapour compression refrigeration cycle, refrigerants and component functions.
